meta.name: finishing-a-development-branch
meta.description: Use when implementation is complete, all tests pass, and you need to decide how to integrate the work - guides completion of development work by presenting structured options for merge, PR, or cleanup

copy.tagline: 完成开发分支后，自动引导合并、提PR或清理
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果开发完一个分支后不确定下一步操作
copy.tagline_en: Guide merge, PR, or cleanup after finishing a branch
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you finish a development branch and need to decide next steps

howto.what: 当开发完成、测试通过后，Claude 会提供合并、创建 PR、保留或丢弃分支等选项，并执行所选操作。
howto.when: 当实现完成、所有测试通过，需要决定如何整合工作时触发。

say.text: 功能开发完了，测试都通过了，帮我收尾。
say.note: Claude 会验证测试并展示选项菜单。

say.text: 合并这个分支到主分支。
say.note: Claude 会执行本地合并并清理工作树。

say.text: 把这个分支推上去创建 PR。
say.note: Claude 会推送分支并保留工作树。

howto.what_en: When development is complete and tests pass, Claude offers options to merge, create a PR, keep, or discard the branch, then executes the chosen action.
howto.when_en: Triggered when implementation is complete, all tests pass, and you need to decide how to integrate the work.

say_en.text: Feature is done, tests pass. Help me finish this branch.
say_en.note: Claude will verify tests and show options menu.
Claude will merge locally and clean up worktree.

say_en.text: Push this branch and create a PR.
say_en.note: Claude will push and keep worktree alive.
